1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __embedded in the test tube at a location that is distinct from surface affixation__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP is not accessible from the exterior surface of the test tube__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the __bottom surface of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards __through the bottom surface__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __configured for long-term storage of biological samples at cryogenic temperatures__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and is thermally bonded to the polymer material such that the MTP is mechanically integrated with the polymer structure__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and __at least two of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system is configured to enable automated tracking and retrieval of samples__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20 C or less __and wherein the MTP remains readable at such temperatures__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP __to create a thermally bonded interface between the MTP and the plastic material__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP __that is not accessible from the exterior surface of the test tube__; and reading the MTP __through the bottom surface of the test tube__.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20 C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and is thermally bonded to the polymer material such that the MTP is mechanically integrated with the polymer structure__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the __bottom surface of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards __through the bottom surface__.
